Keys starting with '_' are comments. NB keyed by decision (episode+frame), so a conflicting re-tag of the same decision is covered by one entry. DESIGN: this is a SET-ASIDES ledger — it lists ONLY corrections held off fresh work by human judgment. Corrections satisfied by a shipped rule, and tactical / no-obs skips, are handled automatically by the tuner and are intentionally NOT listed here — which is why this file stays small even after a whole build has been reviewed (see _reviewed_builds).
